a2a.originalTaskMissing: Original task record not found. Its outcome is unconfirmed.
a2a.taskAttributionHint: These are platform call records, not model conclusions. Another task succeeding in the same context does not establish original task success. Mapping caller and remote task IDs still requires explicit evidence.
a2a.otherContextTasks: Other tasks in this context (retry linkage unconfirmed)
a2a.otherTasksTruncated: Only the latest 20 other task records are shown.
a2a.taskRecordsUnavailable: Task records could not be read. Outcome is unconfirmed. Please check again.
a2a.remoteMappingRecorded: Mapping and result were received from the peer and saved locally. Original call status is retained separately.
a2a.diskReplyLabel: Disk reply matched by remote task ID
a2a.stopScope: Stopping chat stops the caller run only. Remote work may continue; request cancellation separately from the exact task record.
a2a.deliveryGuarantee: A caller task ID is submitted once: completed calls read the saved result, while in-flight or uncertain calls are never resent automatically. A new task ID is a new task. Receivers must provide business idempotency keys for side effects such as writing files or sending messages.
a2a.restartGuarantee: Tasks are not resumed automatically after an Agent restart. The platform keeps the mapping and checks native state or an exact disk reply; without complete evidence it reports an uncertain outcome.
a2a.cancelTaskDescription: Request cancellation only for the mapped remote task. Protocol cancellation does not guarantee underlying tools stop immediately or undo completed actions. The task will not be resubmitted automatically.
a2a.cancelTaskConfirmed: The peer confirmed protocol task cancellation. Completed actions are not undone.
a2a.cancelTaskUnknown: Remote cancellation could not be confirmed. The task may have ended, its record may be missing, or the connection may have failed. Check the records; do not assume underlying operations have stopped.

remoteLookup.not_found: The peer no longer has this task, possibly after a restart or cleanup. No complete disk reply was found; the outcome remains uncertain. Nothing is resent automatically.
remoteLookup.unavailable: The peer query failed. Previous evidence is retained below and does not mean the task is still running. Nothing is resent automatically.
remoteLookup.disk_reply: The peer task query record is missing. A complete disk reply was matched by peer, context and remote task ID. This does not resume execution or restore the native task state.

a2a.remoteMappingPending: Mapping saved; final result has not been fully received. This is the last recorded state, not guaranteed current remote state.
a2a.checkFinishedHint: This review has ended. It does not establish remote task success. Check the actual call result in the response and the corresponding task in collaboration activity.
a2a.checkScopeHint: This conversation is linked to the original collaboration task. Review status tracks this conversation only; check actual call results and the corresponding activity for remote completion.
a2a.draftLinkedHint: Linked to the original collaboration task. Review the draft before sending. A completed review does not establish remote task success.
a2a.draftUnlinkedHint: The draft or mode has changed. This will be sent as an ordinary message without a recovery link. Restore the original draft and use Agent mode to restore the link.
a2a.recoveryMissingRequest: The complete request is unavailable or too long. Supply it before retrying; the summary is not a replayable request.
a2a.recoveryDraftHint: Opens an editable draft with the original context and task IDs. Nothing is sent automatically. Check results before repeating a task that may already have taken effect.
a2a.recoveryPeerUnavailable: This peer is no longer selected or accessible. Review the collaboration configuration first.
a2a.recoveryRequestPlaceholder: [Complete original request required; do not execute the summary]

recoveryReasons.check_result: Check the original result first. A timeout or unconfirmed status does not prove the remote task stopped.
recoveryReasons.check_auth: Repair the credential configuration first, then inspect the original task before retrying.
recoveryReasons.check_service: Check the peer service and the original result before preparing another attempt.

a2a.toolCheckHint: Tool checks inspect current configuration and registration without calling a model. Task execution still needs verification.
a2a.observedRecordsHint: Summaries use readable records. Unconfirmed remote tasks are not marked cancelled, and truncated or missing evidence cannot establish full success.
a2a.guideOn: Next: select peers, then save and apply
a2a.guideSteps: Enable collaboration → Select agents → Save and apply → Check service. Selecting peers does not enable collaboration.
a2a.applyScope: This saves settings and requests redeployment of {{name}} only, briefly interrupting that instance. Deployment still requires confirmation. Peers must be enabled and applied separately.
a2a.pendingApply: Settings are saved, but the current container has not adopted them. Apply, then check the service.
a2a.applicationUnknown: Adoption of these settings is not confirmed. Legacy instances or a failed container check also show this notice.
a2a.peerNotRunning: Not running; check the peer instance
a2a.discoveryOnly: An accessible discovery endpoint does not verify task authentication or execution. After both sides apply their settings, run a collaboration task in Agent mode.
a2a.title: Agent collaboration (A2A)
a2a.subtitle: Use A2A v1.0 to discover capabilities, hand off tasks, and retain auditable collaboration records between trusted Agents.
a2a.loadFailed: The A2A configuration for this instance is temporarily unavailable.
a2a.saveFailed: The A2A configuration was not saved.
a2a.savedRedeployRequired: A2A settings saved securely. Redeploy to apply them.
a2a.unsupportedTitle: This Agent version does not support A2A
a2a.unsupportedDescription: The current version is {{version}}. Upgrade to stable v2026.8.3 or newer first.
a2a.enableDescription: Saving does not restart the instance. A2A starts and joins the internal network after an explicit redeploy.
a2a.securityNotice: The control plane uses an internal Docker network and creates no host or public port. Tokens are encrypted in the platform database.
a2a.trustedPeersDescription: Select only instances that need to hand work to each other. The peer must also enable A2A and be redeployed.
a2a.noPeers: There are no other eligible Agent instances under this account.
a2a.peerCapabilitiesHint: Up to 8, separated by commas or spaces. Save and redeploy to route a2a_orchestrate by capability.
a2a.recentActivityDescription: A read-only view of recent A2A requests, responses, direction, and persisted contexts. Access tokens are never included.
a2a.noFilteredActivity: No collaboration tasks match this filter.
a2a.noActivity: No A2A collaboration activity yet. Completed Agent calls will appear here.

a2a.authRecoveryDescription: Open and redeploy peer {{peer}} first so it applies its current token. Then redeploy this instance to refresh its trusted credential. Another token rotation is usually unnecessary.
a2a.peerUnavailable: This peer Agent is not currently available in the manageable instance list.
a2a.orchestrationTimelineDescription: Concurrent tasks in one context are shown per node. This appears only when two or more nodes are detected.
a2a.rotateDescription: The old token becomes invalid after this instance is redeployed. Other instances that trust this Agent must also be redeployed to receive the new credential.
a2a.rotatedRedeployRequired: Token rotated. Redeploy the affected instances to apply it.
a2a.rotateFailed: A new A2A token could not be generated.
a2a.checkFailedHint: Check failed. Retry to confirm whether settings are applied.
a2a.verificationHint: Checks use saved peers. Once both configurations are applied and discovery is reachable, prepare a chat verification. This only fills a draft; it does not send a message or invoke a model.
a2a.verificationNoPeers: Select peers and save the configuration first.
a2a.readyForTest: Peer configuration applied and discovery reachable. See the call records below for task results.
a2a.guideApplied: Saved configuration applied. Start a collaboration or review task records.
a2a.activityLoadFailed: Could not load collaboration records. Task results cannot be confirmed. Select Refresh records to retry.
a2a.serviceNeedsCheck: Peer discovery is unavailable. Check its runtime and deployment logs.
a2a.verificationDraft: Use A2A tools to run a minimal collaboration check with instance {{peerId}}: ask it to reply only MYBAY_A2A_OK, without reading or changing files or performing other tasks. Show the actual tool result. Report unavailable tools, authentication failures, or incomplete tasks honestly; Agent Card discovery alone is not task success.
